notes.title: Official Release Date - May 23rd
notes.notes:
Wacky Cartoon Racers will be released May 23rd!

We've added the Skeleton King, Fairy Forests, Castles and other fun areas.


New trailer and screenshots will be posted closer to the release.

notes.title: Release Date Pushed Back
notes.notes:
Hey gamers!  The release date for this game has been pushed back a few weeks.

We want to make sure you enjoy this game, so we're adding additional content like voice overs and extra characters for the release.  

Feel free to post in the forums with any feedback/comments!
